text:
maria_pm: Heads-up — AcmeData field pilot asked for: 2x burst credits, per-route throughput bump, and an overage-grace clause for first 90 days. Need quick decision: temporary pilot add-on vs expanding Starter tier. Thoughts?

alex_p: +1 on quick decision. My instinct: offer a pilot add-on (timeboxed) so we don’t shift tier economics. propose price = $2k/month for pilot add-on (covers capacity + priority).

sam_sales: AcmeData will sign a 6-month pilot if we give a 60-day soft grace window and ability to convert to annual commit after month 3. they're sensitive to any upfront cap.

lio_finance: Need modeled P&L. If pilot add-on = $2k/mo, show incremental margin after infra costs. Also propose overage rate = 1.5x list for bursts beyond softcap during grace. softcap threshold ideas: +100% baseline qps or +2x tokens.

nina_legal: We can do a pilot clause but avoid long-term precedent. Draft clause (can be in SOW):
```
Pilot Add-On & Overage Grace:
- Duration: 6 months pilot; grace period for overages: first 60 days waived up to 20% above committed throughput.
- Post-grace: overages billed at 1.5x standard overage rate; customer may convert to a committed contract with 30 days' notice.
- Audit & logging retained for pilot period; Redwood retains right to cap if abuse detected.
```
We’ll need exec sign-off on the waived-overage language.

devon_se: Engineering note: per-route throughput bump requires config changes (route-level concurrency cap + autoscale rule). We can ship a Pilot Add-On flag that raises route limit and enables burst queueing. ETA: 2 sprints for safe rollout (feature + canary). Monitoring will need custom dashboards (latency, queue length, error-rate).

jess_support: Support coverage: agree 24/7 for severity 1 during pilot? That’s higher than standard. We can provide extended hours support but prefer on-call only for critical incidents. Also need runbook for throttling scenarios.

maria_pm: Proposed launch criteria (must-haves): 1) legal clause cleared; 2) finance sign-off on pricing and overage; 3) engineering canary + dashboards; 4) support runbook + playbook; 5) a success metric (<=5% p50 latency increase, <1% error rate, and customer NPS >=7 at month 3). If all green, pilot goes live.

alex_p: Operational details: implement pilot as an "add-on" SKU with start/end dates, a softcap param, and auto-fallback to baseline behavior when cap exceeded 3x in a 1h window. Also add a promo code flow for sales.

lio_finance: Request: produce a short ROI note for CRO and CFO showing downside (cost of spikes) and upside (conversion scenarios). I can sign off after that.

nina_legal: Also require: audit logging note + limited liability carveout for pilot. I can draft SOW language by EOD if product confirms scope.

sam_sales: Timeline: AcmeData wants to start pilot ~3 weeks from now. Sales needs decision on pricing and legal bullet points by EOD Friday to lock the customer.

maria_pm: Action items: @alex_p draft SKU + promo flow; @lio_finance ROI note; @nina_legal SOW draft; @devon_se estimate & canary plan; @jess_support runbook. I’ll gather approvals and reconvene Thu morning. :calendar:

alex_p: I’ll drop a PR with SKU proto and sample billing lines today.
